## PAYMENT PROCESSING TERMS OF SERVICE

You may have the option, at our discretion, of taking advantage of our payment processing offering ("FieldFlow Payments") to process your customers' payments via credit or debit card, ACH or automated funds transfer, subject to our approval of your eligibility for such offerings. Such offerings are subject to certain fees as disclosed to you at the time of sign up, or as posted on our website. By using FieldFlow Payments, you acknowledge and agree that we may use third-party payment processors or other service providers ("Third-Party Payment Processors") and that the terms and privacy policies of any such Third-Party Payment Processors are applicable to you. We currently use Stripe as our payment processor. By registering for or using FieldFlow Payments, you agree to be bound by the Stripe Services Agreement and Stripe Connected Account Agreement, and any other terms contained therein. FieldFlow is not liable for the acts or omissions of any third-party, including any Third-Party Payment Processor. See below for additional terms and conditions regarding your access to and use of FieldFlow Payments.

**Card Not Present**

You acknowledge that all payment or financial card ("Card") transactions (except those conducted using card readers provided by us or using Tap to Pay on Mobile, as available through us) are processed as "card not present" transactions, even where the consumer is at the physical point of sale. You acknowledge that a consumer has different Chargeback rights for "card not present" transactions than for transactions where the buyer physically presents the card to the seller.

**Underwriting**

We will review some or all of the information that you submit in connection with your request to sign up for FieldFlow Payments. We may forward such information to Third-Party Payment Processors or Third-Party Financial Partners (as defined below). After you submit your application, we or our payment processor may conclude that you will not be permitted to use FieldFlow Payments.

**Payment Processing Transaction and Account Reviews**

From time to time, and in our sole discretion, we review account and transaction activity, including when bank transfers are initiated, to evaluate your eligibility, or continued eligibility, to access our processing and other financial related product offerings. This review checks for, among other things, suspicious or illegal activity, and whether your account activity and the activity of users with whom you've transacted comply with this Agreement. In connection with our review process, you may be required to provide us with additional information and/or documentation to verify your identity, business information, or financial standing. We also may obtain information from third parties, including but not limited to consumers and financial institutions, and we may contact your customers to obtain relevant information. We may limit your account and your access to money in it or that is sent to you until verification is completed.

Reviews may result in:

– delayed, blocked or canceled transfers;

– money or payments being held by us;

– money or payments being applied to amounts you owe to us or used to offset loss incurred by us;

– account limitation, suspension or termination;

– money or payments being seized to comply with a court order, warrant or other legal process; and/or

– money or payments you previously received being reversed (i.e., sent back to the sender or to the card or bank account that was used to fund the payment).

Among other reasons, we may take the above actions if you knowingly or unknowingly were a participant in a payment that was made from a stolen card, compromised bank account, or compromised FieldFlow account, or if you were a participant in a transaction for goods and services between two personal accounts.

**Transaction Limits**

We may impose various transaction limits and rules on Customers. If you believe that the transaction limits are interfering with your business, please contact our support to request higher limits. We may require more information about your business to evaluate your request and will decide at our sole discretion whether to honor such requests. We will consider a variety of factors in making our decision, including but not limited to a proprietary set of rules, Chargeback rates, transaction behavior, and other supplemental data about your business.

**Restrictions on Certain Transactions**

You may not use FieldFlow Payments for activities unrelated to the activities described in your Business Profile. Without limiting the generality of the foregoing, you may not use FieldFlow Payments for shipping products, for selling products not related to on-site work in the business described in your Business Profile, receiving payments on loans, for cash advances, or for transactions involving motor vehicles.

**Payment Processing Fees**

You agree to pay payment processing or other transaction-related fees ("Payment Processing Fees"). We reserve the right to change our Payment Processing Fees at any time in our sole discretion.

**Surcharging**

While Surcharging is made available to help you apply surcharges to credit card transactions, FieldFlow does not warrant or represent that Surcharging complies with applicable laws, regulations, and credit card brand/network rules and requirements ("Card Rules"), and it does not constitute legal, compliance, tax, or financial advice of any kind. You agree not to impose a surcharge in any jurisdiction where doing so is prohibited. You agree that you are solely and exclusively responsible for ensuring that your surcharging practices are lawful and comply with Card Rules, including without limitation with respect to: (i) registration or notification to card networks and/or your acquiring bank; (ii) surcharge caps and permissible surcharge amounts; (iii) the types of card transactions to which a surcharge may be applied; (iv) required notices and disclosures to your customers; and (v) equal treatment requirements across card brands.

FieldFlow may immediately suspend or terminate your access to Surcharging if we determine, in our sole discretion, that: (i) your use of Surcharging violates applicable law, Card Rules, or this Agreement; (ii) your surcharging practices have resulted or may result in chargebacks, card network fines, penalties, or assessments to FieldFlow or its Third-Party Providers; (iii) a card network or payment processor requires or requests such action; or (iv) continued provision of Surcharging to you creates legal, regulatory, reputational, or financial risk to FieldFlow or its Third-Party Providers.

**Automated Sales Tax**

Automated Sales Tax ("AST") is made available as a tool to calculate and apply estimated sales tax rates to your jobs and invoices based on your customer's service address and the type of work performed. AST does not constitute legal, compliance, tax, or financial advice of any kind. You agree that: (i) you are solely and exclusively responsible for determining, collecting, verifying, and remitting all applicable taxes, including sales tax, arising from your services in each applicable jurisdiction; (ii) FieldFlow does not guarantee that AST will reflect the most up-to-date rates or that the rates applied are correct for your specific services, customers, or circumstances; and (iii) AST may not account for customer tax exemptions or other circumstances affecting the taxability of your services, and you are solely and exclusively responsible for applying any applicable exemptions and for maintaining required documentation. You should consult a qualified tax professional to ensure compliance with all applicable tax laws and regulations.

**Access to Your Funds**

We will deposit to your bank account (defined as the bank account as specified in your FieldFlow account) the amounts actually received by us for transactions submitted through the Service (less any applicable Payment Processing Fees and any money that you owe FieldFlow). We reserve the right to revise our payout schedule. Once your bank account information is verified, we will automatically initiate a payout to your designated bank account at the end of every business day except as provided below. Payouts to your bank account will normally register within 2-3 business days subject to your bank's policies. We may offer you the ability to direct funds to multiple accounts. We may notify you that a payment has been made or initiated by a customer, however, you should review your FieldFlow account to confirm the status of any such payments.

Transactions will be deemed complete when we or the designated financial institutions have accepted the transaction or funds. We will attempt to rectify processing errors that we discover, and may withhold funds pending our investigation of any such errors. You are responsible for monitoring your transactions and ensuring that our payments to you are correct. You must notify us of any errors in payments made to you within sixty (60) days of the error first appearing on your electronic transaction history, and failure to do so will be deemed a waiver of any right to amounts owed to you. However, notification within such sixty (60) day period does not ensure that any such error will be able to be corrected.

We may make payouts available to you before final settlement of the underlying customer payment. Any such payout is provisional and may be reversed if the underlying payment is returned, reversed, rejected, disputed, stopped, or otherwise invalidated (including for insufficient funds or stop-payment orders). You are responsible for all such reversals and authorize us to recover the full amount from you by debiting your balance, netting future payouts, and/or debiting your designated bank account(s). Any unrecovered amounts are immediately due and payable upon demand.

**Restrictions on Availability of Funds**

Should we need to conduct an investigation or resolve any suspicious activity or pending dispute related to a Customer account, we may delay payout or restrict access to your funds for the entire time it takes for us to do so. We also may delay payout or restrict access to your funds as required by law or court order, or if otherwise requested by law enforcement or governmental entities.

**Chargebacks**

The amount of a transaction may be reversed or charged back to your bank account (a "Chargeback") if the transaction (a) is disputed, (b) is reversed for any reason by the Card Associations (defined below), our processor, or a payer's or our financial institution, (c) was not authorized or we have any reason to believe was not authorized, or (d) is allegedly unlawful, suspicious, or in violation of the terms of this Agreement.

There is a non-refundable $25 fee for each Chargeback regardless of the outcome of the dispute.

**Contesting Chargebacks; Our Collection Rights for Chargebacks.** For any transaction that results in a Chargeback, we may withhold the Chargeback amount in a Reserve (defined below). In the event a customer charges back a payment that we have processed and caused funds to be delivered to your account, (i) our payment processor, Stripe, may withhold or take back such amounts while the charge is in dispute and (ii) you will be solely responsible for refunding to the customer the amount of any and all Payment Processing fees from the original transaction (and you authorize FieldFlow to refund such amounts to the consumer from your account). In such event, if your account does not have sufficient funds, we may be required to advance such funds to Stripe on your behalf. If this occurs, you agree that we are entitled to be reimbursed by you immediately, and that your sole remedy lies with your customer and your customer's bank.
